//: Which recorded call is which endpoint. The human half of the codegen boundary — a generator that guessed would produce something that looks right and fails silently. Signatures come from `pnpm patreon calls <har>`.
//POST_CREATE: There is no create call. The draft is minted by navigating to the editor: GET /posts/new answers 302 to /<page>/posts/{id}/edit, and that redirect is the first place the new post id exists.
//POST_DELETE: Delete goes through the bulk endpoint even for one post, and answers 201 with an async job (is_completed:false). Captured in `cleanup`.
//MEDIA: media create returns an S3 presigned POST in attributes.upload_url + attributes.upload_parameters, and attributes.state goes pending_upload -> ready.
//CSRF: Not a cookie: the jar carries no csrf entry at all. A small endpoint hands out the token and it goes in x-csrf-signature.
